audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Skill and 2+ items read Jax on both layers, against the mirror.
audit.why: The mirror audit (jax__warwick) set the Level 6 row to Jax and the 2+ items row to Warwick in both layers as one atomic group, and explicitly left rows 0 and 2 alone. Level 3 already reads Jax here, matching them.
audit.corrected: Rows 4 and 6 flipped on both layers as one atomic group with ratings rescaled, and whys[4] and whys[6] rewritten to agree. Rows 0 and 2 left untouched, matching the mirror's own decision. diff moved EVEN to TRICKY at 7/10 on a 47.86% win rate — 8.5/10 with a red tone and a diff of EVEN was three-way inconsistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; the 2+ item stage had no mechanism for why it comes back to Warwick.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s and Empower drops to a 3s cooldown, so the punish window shrinks by eight seconds across the game — that is the real spike, not an item name. The two-item stage returns to Warwick because Jaws of the Beast scales off the target's maximum health and Eternal Hunger triples below 25% of Warwick's own health, so the health and resists Jax stacks feed the bite.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[4].why, phases[6].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[1], spikes[3], late and whys[6].

audit.whatIsWrong: mid tells you to disengage with "E's shield-into-slow". Primal Howl has neither a shield nor a slow. spikes[1] and wants.you[1] tell you to ult into Counter Strike to cancel it.
audit.why: Primal Howl gives 2.5 seconds of damage reduction and then a 1-second fear, 15s at rank 1 — the mirror agent found it absent from the entire matchup and wrote it into their side. And Infinite Duress is a channel: Counter Strike's stun cancels it, so ulting into an active E loses the fight rather than winning it. Whether suppression pre-empts the delayed counterattack is not in Riot's text, so I did not assert the reverse either — the advice is simply to wait the 17 seconds out.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl described correctly in mid; spikes[1] and wants.you[1] rewritten to bait-then-ult rather than ult-to-cancel.

audit.why: The mirror flagged "Counter Strike's" as a false-positive suspect name; the packet for this side returns no suspects at all and every ability name on the page checks out against the kit.
